_readme.title: Vayu + VIB Integrator Roadmap
_readme.source: Roadmap supplied by the user for website synchronization.
_readme.status_policy: Statuses reflect the supplied roadmap. Do not mark implementation complete without repository and test evidence.

phase_status.planned: Planned, awaiting authorization, or deferred by project decision.

_readme.notes: Phases 0.1–0.4, 1.1–1.4, 2.1–2.6, 3.1–3.10, 0.5a, 4.1, and 4.2 are complete. Phase 0.5b is awaiting explicit authorization before changes to compiler/interp/** or compiler/vm/**. Phase 4.3 is deferred until the calls/index-expression infrastructure in Phases 5 and 7. Phase 5.1 is the next implementation target and is represented as Planned, not a separate Next status. The 2A–2C workstreams remain deferred by project decision and are represented as Planned. Only Completed, Working, Planned, and Vacation are valid statuses. --native currently means Integrator-mediated in-memory VIR execution; it does not claim native machine-code generation.
